title: Berkeley Measure X Passed: What Changes for Landlords, and When

findings.quote: Before Measure X, there was no percentage limit on how much banked increase could be taken at once. Now there is.
findings.root_cause: One present-tense claim remains in 'The 10% Cap' section despite the effective-date corrections elsewhere.
findings.fix: Before Measure X takes effect, there is no banking-specific percentage cap on an otherwise lawful increase up to the unit's rent ceiling. Once Measure X takes effect, AGA-based increases will be limited to 10% in a 12-month period.
